proposal.summary: IBAN format failures in refund payments cause customers to inquire about refund status, leading to perceived waiting for answers. We observed five refund payments failed due to IBAN format errors (E-02), ticket response times are well within SLA (median 2 h vs 24 h SLA) indicating delays are not from slow handling (E-01), and stakeholders report customers feel they wait for answers (E-03). Based on the observed IBAN format failures (E-02), the released scope is to monitor those failures in DA‑PAY. The Define gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, deferring the unknown proportion of refund inquiries due to IBAN failures (U-UNKNOWN-01) as VOB-U-UNKNOWN-01, which lies outside the release scope, resulting in a release with known limitation. Limitations: DEFINE Gate CONDITIONAL_PASS (deferred items tracked as VOBs) [U-UNKNOWN-01]; VOB-U-UNKNOWN-01 open; blocking_scope outside release scope [VOB-U-UNKNOWN-01]; Policy clarity impact on refund inquiries is not quantified [H-POLICY-UNCLEAR].
